easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger, and putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Smothering Tithe triggers, creating a Treasure token, as the opponent who drew a card cannot pay for its trigger.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
